description: We met for the first time at a mutual friend's superbowl party.
We exchanged our first direct messages on social media.
We attended our first tractor show together.
We went on our first vacation together in St. Louis where we attended the Gateway Dirt Nationals.
Nick proposed to Maddie at the Greater Des Moines Botanical Garden in the middle of the holiday lights display.
We celebrated our engagement with our immediate family.
We are getting married at Windmill Hill in Manchester, Iowa!
